title: Nova One — a fanless laptop launch
description: A light, premium launch page for an invented 13.6-inch fanless laptop. In the hero you drag a lamp around a lit stage and the laptop's display retunes its white point and brightness to the room in real time. Then a cycling 'silent' statement, a before/after ambient display slider, a keyboard you can type on, a pinned design story with a 3D battery calendar, a full configurator with finishes, add-ons and a rolling total, specs and FAQ.
sections: Hero with draggable ambient lamp stage
features: Draggable lamp that relights the stage and retunes the laptop screen through motion values
Before/after slider comparing ambient display off and on
Typeable lit keyboard with record and replay
3D standing battery calendar in the brand colour
Configurator with finishes, tiers, capsule toggles, quantity stepper and rolling total
